name: Christ The Prophet
overview: Christ is revealed in Scripture as the prophet foretold by Isaiah, chosen and anointed by God to bring judgment and truth to the nations, as seen in Matthew 12:17-20. His ministry is marked by meekness and unwavering faithfulness, demonstrating wisdom and power through both word and deed. In Matthew 24:3-4, Jesus emphasizes the importance of heeding his prophetic warnings about the future, underscoring God's command to listen closely to His voice.
